convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA, iEnvelopes) with standard parameters. Simple entry/exit rules based on candle patterns and MA/Envelopes. Fixed lots position sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No complex money management or multi-timeframe logic.

long.left: Three Candles Pattern (3 consecutive bullish closes above MA and above Envelopes Lower Band)
long.right: Close[2] > MA[2] AND Close[1] > MA[1] AND Close[0] > MA[0] AND Close[2] > Envelopes_Lower[2] AND Close[1] > Envelopes_Lower[1] AND Close[0] > Envelopes_Lower[0]

short.left: Three Candles Pattern (3 consecutive bearish closes below MA and below Envelopes Upper Band)
short.right: Close[2] < MA[2] AND Close[1] < MA[1] AND Close[0] < MA[0] AND Close[2] < Envelopes_Upper[2] AND Close[1] < Envelopes_Upper[1] AND Close[0] < Envelopes_Upper[0]

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (position_gate no_position enforced via reversal)

custom_logic_notes: The 'Three Candles' strategy requires 3 consecutive completed bars where each bar's close is on the same side of both the Moving Average and the respective Envelope band (lower for longs, upper for shorts). The EA checks bars at indices [2], [1], and [0] (last 3 completed bars). Digit adjustment is applied: SL and TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001. Position direction is tracked via a custom variable (Pos) rather than relying solely on PositionSelect, allowing the EA to maintain state about which side it last traded on. The EA uses Open method for order execution with explicit filling mode detection (ORDER_FILLING_FOK or ORDER_FILLING_IOC depending on what the broker supports).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Built-in SMA and Envelopes are easily replicated with pandas/numpy. The 3-candle consecutive pattern is a simple boolean check on the last 3 bars. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit) should be handled by normalizing to proper pip units in Python. The CTrade wrapper from Trade.mqh maps directly to simple market order functions. No custom indicators or complex dependencies.
